name: Curing the Sick

guaranteedRewards.name: Veildust Medicine Bag
tooltip: Use: Restores 50 mana every 3 sec for 15 sec. (30 Min Cooldown)

narrative.details:
The amount of salve made out of the reagents you brought me is good enough for ten doses, adventurer.  While I work with the village to try and make some more salve, I'd like for you to help us get a head start.  All around Darkshore are sickly deer; use the salve on them and cure their malaise.

Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure.  Please extend Auberdine's thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... and let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!
narrative.objectives: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them.  Sickly Deer have been reported starting south of the Cliffspring River to the north of Auberdine and extending all the way into southern Darkshore where the edge of Ashenvale begins.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have done well in tending to the sickly deer of Darkshore; they are unwitting victims of a greater taint and corruption that is spreading all throughout the land.  There are those in Darnassus who choose to recognize this threat... and there are those who ignore the growing signs.  I hope you will not be one to put blinders on about what facts stare you in the face, adventurer.

Regardless, you've proven your worth as a friend of nature and the Circle - take this as a symbol of such.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you completed what was asked of you by Alanndarian Nightsong of Auberdine? Your work is not complete unless it is.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 14, 3,325 XP in all.

quests.name: Lessons Anew
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: The Principal Source
quests.objectiveText: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls. Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong

quests.name: Gathering the Cure
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.

quests.name: Curing the Sick
quests.objectiveText: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them.

quests.name: Power over Poison
quests.objectiveText: Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
